leftEvidence.title: Wisdom links death with the devil’s envy

points.label: Causal wording
points.left: Wisdom says God made humanity for incorruption and that death entered the world through the devil’s envy.
points.right: Paul says sin entered through one man and death through sin, then names Adam and describes death reigning from Adam to Moses.

points.label: Source setting
points.left: Adam in wisdom and reflection · analytical context · Wisdom 2:23–24
points.right: Adam, Christ, and embodied life · later memory · Romans 5:12–14

payload.posture: Death entered the world through the devil’s envy is held beside Death entered through sin after sin entered through one man.

rightEvidence.title: Romans traces sin and death through one man

payload.tension: Wisdom names the devil’s envy, while Romans traces death through sin and one man.
payload.title: Later sources name death’s entry differently
